correctness.rationale: Exact run decomposition and a greedy phase argument prove the minimum span for all a,b>0 and every nonempty pattern. Disjoint endpoint/internal-run weighted enumeration gives the rational series. For block capacities at least two a nonnegative slack D and parity decomposition give sharp extremal spans; shorter block size one is separately handled. Exhaustive independent reference-span tests passed 36,792 cases, thresholds 324, generating-series coefficients 667, without treating finite tests as proof.

value.rationale: The bounded-range subsequence model is a motivated difficulty for generic text input. The basic natural two-dwell-time periodic family receives a full exact parametric description of all distinct length-k patterns by minimum window length and an explicit rational series, plus a sharp phase transition in the universal window threshold at minimum dwell sizes 1, 2 and 3. This replaces repeated finite enumeration with an infinite structural classification, though no complexity-theoretic generalization is claimed.
